stem.zh-CN: 在分类任务中，[[term:softmax|Softmax 函数]]的作用是？
stem.en-US: In a classification task, what does the [[term:softmax|Softmax function]] do?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:softmax|Softmax 函数]]将神经网络的原始输出（[[term:logits|logits]]）转换为[[term:probability-distribution|概率分布]]，每个类别的概率值介于0到1之间，且所有类别的概率之和为1，适用于[[term:classification|多分类任务]]。
explanation.en-US: The [[term:softmax|Softmax function]] converts the neural network's raw outputs ([[term:logits|logits]]) into a [[term:probability-distribution|probability distribution]]. Each class probability lies between 0 and 1, all class probabilities sum to 1, and the result is suitable for [[term:classification|multiclass classification]].

text.zh-CN: 将输入映射到[-1,1]区间用于激活
text.en-US: Maps inputs to the [-1, 1] interval for activation

text.zh-CN: 将输入转换为对数概率用于交叉熵损失
text.en-US: Converts inputs into log probabilities for cross-entropy loss

text.zh-CN: 限制输出范围以防止梯度爆炸
text.en-US: Limits the output range to prevent exploding gradients

text.zh-CN: 将输入映射到[0,1]区间表示[[term:probability-distribution|概率分布]]
text.en-US: Maps inputs to the [0, 1] interval as a [[term:probability-distribution|probability distribution]]
